metrics.result:
That notification is about the background `find` search I started while looking for the renderer. It hit its time limit and was stopped. I don't need it any more, because I found the renderer another way, so I won't restart it.

The video is unaffected. `out/film.mp4` (5 s, 1080p) and `./film.reel` are in place as described above.

checklist.evidence: Yellow circle with dark diamond and white bold Lumen wordmark drawn from the SVG, outline-to-fill visible.

checklist.item: a reveal animation (not just a fade)
checklist.evidence: Circle strokes on, outlines draw, then fills in. Wordmark fades up from grey.

checklist.item: logo holds still at the end
checklist.evidence: Frames 3.1–4.8s show the logo size still changing slightly (slow scale drift), so it isn't fully static. The change is subtle, so it mostly reads as a settle.

problems: Reveal is a plain stroke-draw then fill. It's clean but generic, with no glow, light sweep or accent to make it 'cool'.
The first ~0.8s is nearly empty, with just a faint thin outline. It looks slow and weak.
The wordmark's pale outline and grey fade-in are low-contrast and feel less polished than the mark.
The logo sits fairly small with a lot of empty dark space, and the end hold is a flat static lockup with no tagline or finishing flourish.
The slow scale drift at the end never fully settles.
judge.verdict: The real logo is shown correctly on a dark background, and the stroke-draw into fill reads as a proper reveal. It's competent but generic. A user would probably accept it, though it isn't especially cool."
